beats.title: PR Merged with Pragmatic Validation Scope
beats.body: The PR was merged on 2020-10-21 after the contributor added castling-contradiction checks, touching-kings detection, and royal-king-count validation as requested. The team explicitly accepted that the validator would not catch every possible invalid FEN, prioritizing a low false-negative rate over exhaustive coverage. The maintainer noted residual concerns about how variant-specific conditions were defined but approved the merge, intending to refine those conditions later.

beats.title: Engineering Lessons
lessons: Shipping an imperfect validator that avoids false negatives is often more valuable than delaying for exhaustive correctness, especially for user-input validation.
Variant-rich domains force validators to reason about rule prerequisites bottom-up rather than filtering by known variant names, which is more robust and maintainable.
When a contributor lacks deep domain knowledge, merging with documented limitations and a clear path for incremental improvement beats blocking on perfection.
